entities.summary: Yehuda Magidovitch was one of the most prolific Israeli architects. Among his prominent works are the Galei Aviv Casino, a café-restaurant, the great synagogue of Tel Aviv, the former Soviet Embassy in Tel Aviv and the Cinema Esther, both in Tel Aviv.
